messages.content: Read the following text out loud: I've bought myself lots of things, she defended herself. Most of this is really for me and - I can't help being good to him. It's only common humanity.

Read the following text out loud: His little crumpled black muzzle on the pillow close to Allan's contented sleeping face, she felt as if she wanted to cry the pathetic lack of interests which made the coming of a new little dog such an event.

Read the following text out loud: She wondered afterwards how she could have spoken with that hard serenity, how she could have gone steadily on with story after story, poem after poem, till Allan's grip on her hands relaxed and he fell into a heavy, tired sleep.
